_comment: Reference catalogue. Every other locale must define the same key set; internal/i18n.Load fails at startup otherwise, and the parity test enforces it.
rflag.opt.invalid.name: Invalid
rflag.opt.invalid.help: Hide this realm from the client's realm list entirely.
rflag.opt.build.name: Show build
rflag.opt.build.help: Append the client build to the realm name.
rflag.opt.newPlayers.name: New players
rflag.opt.newPlayers.help: Mark the realm as recommended for new players.
rflag.opt.recommended.name: Recommended
home.lead: Create an account, manage your characters and keep an eye on your account from the browser. The same credentials work in the game client.
login.title: Sign in
login.hint: Use the same account name and password as the game client.
reg.title: Create account
reg.accountHint: 3–16 characters: letters, digits, underscore, dash. Not case sensitive.
reg.passwordHint: At least %d and at most 16 characters. The game client only accepts 16.
panel.noCharacters: You have not created any characters yet. Log into the game to make one.
panel.disabledBanner: This account is disabled and cannot log into the game.
chars.title: My characters
chars.name: Name
chars.confirmUnstick: Move %s back to its home location?
chars.unstickHelp: Unstick moves a character that is stuck in terrain back to its homebind (inn) location. It only works while the character is offline: the server keeps a logged-in character in memory and would save its old position again on logout.
passwd.title: Change password
passwd.hint: The new password applies to both the game client and this site. All other browser sessions are signed out.
sec.title: Two-factor authentication
sec.statusHint: When enabled, the game client asks for a six digit code from your authenticator app every time you log in. The first successful login from an address is remembered for 30 days.
sec.step1: 1. Add this secret to your authenticator app:
sec.orOpen: Or open this link on the device that runs the app:
sec.step2: 2. Enter the current code to activate it:
sec.confirmWithCode: Confirm with a current code from your app.
sec.turnOnHint: You need an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password, Aegis, …). The code is standard TOTP over SHA-1 with a 30 second window, which the server accepts with one step of clock drift.
sec.noTrusted: No address is currently trusted; every login asks for a code.
sess.title: Active sessions
sess.confirmAll: Sign out every session, including this one?
sess.hint: Sessions last %d hours. Changing your password or an administrator resetting it signs every session out.
admin.title: Administration
admin.name: Name
admin.realmNote: icon and timezone are overwritten by mangosd from GameType/RealmZone on every start, so they are edited in mangosd.conf.
acct.title: Accounts
acct.rankHint: You can only grant ranks up to your own (%s).
acct.selfNote: This is your own account; self-destructive actions are disabled.
acct.disabledNote: This account is disabled and cannot log in.
acct.disableNote: Disabling blocks the game login (realmd rejects inactive accounts) without deleting anything. It is the reversible alternative to deletion.
acct.noBans: No bans recorded for this account.
acct.durationHint: Hours. Use 0 for a permanent ban.
acct.banNote: A ban is written exactly like the in-game ban account command (account_banned, permanent when unbandate equals bandate). It is enforced by realmd/worldmgr on the next login; a player already in game stays connected because this service cannot reach the world server.
acct.confirmResetPassword: Reset the password of %s? All their sessions are signed out.
acct.twoFaRecoveryHint: Use this when a player lost their authenticator device. The secret is cleared and the account can log in again without a code.
acct.deleteNote: Deletes the account, every character on it and all related rows. Characters must be offline. A character that leads a guild must be handled first, because disbanding a guild from here would desynchronise the running world server.
acct.confirmDeleteText: This permanently deletes the account and ALL its characters. Continue?
achar.title: Characters
achar.detail.positionNote: Moving a character writes the homebind position from character_homebind. It only works offline, because the world server overwrites the row with its in-memory position on logout.
achar.detail.disabledOnline: Disabled while the character is online.
achar.detail.confirmRename: Force %s to rename on next login?
achar.detail.renameNote: Applies at_login |= RENAME; the client prompts for a new name at next login.
achar.detail.levelNote: Setting a level bypasses the normal progression and is not reversible; the character keeps its spells and talents.
bans.title: Bans
bans.ipNote: Stored in ip_banned. A duration of 0 is permanent. The world server reads this table on startup and periodically.
realm.title: Realms
realm.intro: realmlist is what the login server hands to the client. The id must match RealmID in mangosd.conf and port must match WorldServerPort — not the realmd login port.
realm.heading: Realm
realm.name: Name
realm.addressHint: The address clients connect to for the world server.
realm.offlineNote: The offline bit is written by mangosd, so it is not offered here.
realm.accessNote: Accounts below this rank see the realm as locked. Useful for maintenance windows.
realm.buildsNote: written by mangosd, never read back
realm.empty: No realm rows exist yet. Create one so the login server can advertise this world:
audit.title: Audit log
audit.hint: The 200 most recent administrative actions, newest first.
err.title: Something went wrong
err.hint: If this keeps happening, contact the server administrator.
err.rankTooLow: Your account rank is too low to open the administration area.
err.serverErrorHint: Something went wrong. The error has been logged.

flash.err.realmNameTaken: Another realm already uses that name.

flash.err.namesOnly: Account names may only contain letters, digits, underscore and dash.

flash.ok.unstuck: %s has been moved back to its home location.

flash.ok.ipUnbanned: The ban on %s has been removed.
flash.ok.realmUpdated: Realm updated. Clients pick the change up on their next realm list refresh.
flash.ok.realmOpen: The realm is open to every account.
flash.ok.realmRestricted: Only accounts of rank %d (%s) or higher may enter.
ann.title: Login announcement
ann.intro: This is the notice the game client shows on the left of its login screen, in the "Server Alert" panel. It is fetched by the client itself, so it appears before anyone logs in.
ann.enabledHint: When off, the panel is served empty so nothing is displayed.
ann.titleHint: The panel's heading comes from the client, so this is only used to label the notice here in the panel.
ann.bodyHint: Plain text. Blank lines separate paragraphs; single line breaks are kept. Maximum 20000 characters.
ann.never: This announcement has never been saved.
ann.previewHint: The client renders this with a cut-down HTML widget, so it is plain text only: no colours, images or links.
ann.empty: Nothing is being served: the announcement is either empty or switched off.
ann.howClient: The game client requests the address above when it draws the login screen. It is a one-way fetch: the client sends no session and expects no cookies.
ann.howPatch: That address is baked into a small client patch (patch-Z.mpq), which overrides the value shipped in the translation pack. Only change it when the site moves.
ann.howDisabled: Editing here takes effect on the next login screen. No server restart and no client patch are needed.
home.signInForStatus: Sign in to see the realm's status and how to connect.
